learning_outcomes.text: Students know the operating principle and application area of various electrical machines.
Students can assess the operating points and starting behavior of electric drives using characteristic curves.
Students learn the functioning and thermodynamic principles of piston power machines.
They are able to calculate the most important key figures and evaluate motors with them.
Students are able to independently familiarize themselves with new subject areas and successfully apply the acquired knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Typical characteristic values for describing and evaluating internal combustion engines
Fuels and determination of fuel consumption
Combustion calculation and exhaust gas emissions
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam. The weight of the grade for the final grade is determined in the Bachelor's examination regulations.
